276327730.description:
Missouri Meerschaum Corncob Pipe Lot
2 Piece Set, Vintage Tobacco Smoking Pipes
Corncob, Wood, and Plastic, Approximately 6 Inches Long
A pair of vintage corncob tobacco pipes manufactured by the Missouri Meerschaum Company of Washington, Missouri. Founded in 1869, Missouri Meerschaum is the world's oldest and largest manufacturer of corncob pipes, known for their cool-smoking properties and historical significance in American culture. These two examples feature different bowl textures and stem designs, ideal for collectors or enthusiasts of traditional smoking implements.
Lot includes two distinct corncob pipes with wooden stems and amber-toned mouthpieces
One pipe retains the original factory label on the base identifying it as a Missouri Meerschaum original
Handcrafted construction utilizing natural corncob for a unique porous smoking experience
Sizes range from approximately 5.5 to 5.75 inches in total length
Condition:
Bowls show evidence of previous use with light charring visible inside the chambers. The exterior of the corncob bowls remains structurally sound with natural variations in texture. Wood stems are secure. Plastic mouthpieces are intact without significant bite marks or cracks. Base label on one pipe is present and legible with minor edge wear. Generally well-preserved vintage condition.

Raw Amethyst Decorative Specimen
Purple Crystal Cluster on Clear Glass Base
Vintage Style, 8 Inches Tall
This striking decorative piece features a natural raw amethyst cluster securely mounted atop a solid clear glass block. The specimen showcases a dense concentration of crystalline points with a rich spectrum of violet and deep purple hues. The minimalist glass base provides a modern, elevated presentation that highlights the organic textures and geometric forms of the natural mineral formation.
Natural amethyst cluster with varied crystalline terminations and deep purple color density
Securely mounted on a heavy, polished clear glass cube base
Visible natural stone matrix on the reverse side showing authentic geological origins
Overall dimensions: 8" height with a 3" x 3" square base
Condition:
The amethyst cluster is in its natural raw state with inherent crystalline irregularities and matrix textures. The glass block base is structurally sound and clear, though it shows minor signs of previous display such as light surface scratches and adhesive residue from former protective pads on the underside. The specimen is firmly attached to the base.
